derivedBy: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f h264 -i apps/agent/spike/fixtures/idr-1280x720.annexb -pix_fmt gray -f rawvideo /tmp/fixture-gray.raw, then a 4x4 region-mean over the 1280x720 luma plane
note: A black frame is uniform at 16 (or 0). The spread here is ~145 luma levels, so this grid separates 'pixels arrived' from 'the decoder produced a picture of nothing' without tolerance tuning.
